highlights.degree: Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech)

overview: Studying Electronics & Communication - PG in Finland offers Indian students access to world-renowned Nordic education, innovative practical research, English-taught programmes, and excellent European career pathways.

faq.question: What are the tuition fees for Electronics Engineering in Finland?
faq.answer: Annual tuition fees for non-EU/EEA students range between €10,000 and €17,000 per year (approximately ₹10.5 to ₹17.85 lakh per annum). Finnish universities provide generous merit scholarships covering 50% to 100% of tuition.

faq.question: How can Edu-Hawk Worldwide help students apply?
faq.answer: Edu-Hawk Worldwide provides end-to-end guidance from profile assessment, university shortlisting, and SOP drafting to Studyinfo application filing, scholarship assistance, and Finnish residence permit support.
